question: A 100 m long train overtakes a man moving at a speed of 9 km/hr (in same direction) in 30 seconds. How much time (in seconds) will this train take to completely cross another 220 m long train, moving in the opposite direction at a speed of 51 km/hr?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of train A = 100 m

Train A overtakes man (same direction) in 30 sec

Speed of man = 9 km/hr

Speed of train B = 51 km/hr (opposite direction)

Length of train B = 220 m

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Relative Speed (same direction) = Speed of train − Speed of man
